title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The correct drift velocity of 10^{-2} cm/sec must be provided.

title: Use of Formula
description: Important Criteria: The student should apply the formula for drift velocity, which relates current, charge density, and cross-sectional area.

title: Calculation Steps
description: Important Criteria: The student must show clear calculations leading to the final answer, including any necessary conversions.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as incorrect unit conversions or miscalculating the area of the wire.
